_about: Voice pace per line: target words per minute by beat, nudged by emotion and content. The voice step speeds or slows each finished Chatterbox line (ffmpeg atempo, pitch kept) toward its target, within tempo_range. Turbo laugh lines keep their natural pace. Table and reasoning: vault Docs/Voice Pace.md.

content._numbers: a line with a spoken number (twenty twelve, thirty-four million): the ear needs time to hold it

turbo._: lines containing a [chuckle] or [laugh] tag render on Chatterbox Turbo, cloned from the house voice; at most one per video
